summary.description: One to three sentences on the state of the PR.

blocking.description: Every blocking finding that is open at HEAD. The check passes if and only if this is empty.

failure_scenario.description: The specific input or state and the wrong result it produces.

thread_id.description: Id of the existing unresolved thread this finding lives in. Null when this run posted its inline comment.

resolve_thread_ids.description: Prior bot threads now fixed at HEAD, or answered by a reply you accept.

goldens_reviewed.description: Every golden whose sheet you opened and checked against its fixture, by its path in visual/index.md.

nonblocking_count.description: Number of non-blocking observations, posted or not.
